# Mapucoin

> Chile por paisaje: desiertos, playas, viñedos, volcanes, ríos, lagos, bosques y nieve. Cápsulas de cobre y vidrio, gastronomía local y mapa vivo.

Mapucoin is a travel platform at https://mapucoin.com, operated by Salvazion, Inc. (a Delaware corporation). The person sets a budget and a place. Grok builds an itinerary with technological capsules, local gastronomy, and activities, on a map. Independent partners run capsules, meals, and activities. Payments use Stripe (CLP). Mapucoin is a technology platform, not a tour operator. The installable app lives at https://mapucoin.com/app and requires an account. Reserva and the planner require a verified account.

Mapucoin es el nombre de la plataforma de viajes, no un activo. Si la clave $SALVAZION está habilitada, es solo una llave de acceso a Mapucoin Premium: no es una inversión, no genera retornos y no hay promesa de precio.

## Places

Each place has its own page: https://mapucoin.com/destinos/{slug}. Each capsule has its own page: https://mapucoin.com/capsulas/{slug}. The sitemap lists every URL.

- [San Pedro de Atacama](https://mapucoin.com/destinos/san-pedro-de-atacama)
- [Valparaíso](https://mapucoin.com/destinos/valparaiso)
- [Cajón del Maipo](https://mapucoin.com/destinos/cajon-del-maipo)
- [Pucón](https://mapucoin.com/destinos/pucon)
- [Puerto Varas](https://mapucoin.com/destinos/puerto-varas)
- [Chiloé](https://mapucoin.com/destinos/chiloe)
- [Capillas de Mármol](https://mapucoin.com/destinos/capillas-de-marmol)
- [Torres del Paine](https://mapucoin.com/destinos/torres-del-paine)
